mistakes.text: The chain was rusted through; despite, the bike rolled by noon.
mistakes.normalized: the chain was rusted through despite the bike rolled by noon
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Despite“ a „in spite of“ potrebujú podstatné meno; samostatne na začiatku vety patrí „nevertheless“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Despite“ a „in spite of“ potřebují podstatné jméno; samostatně na začátku věty patří „nevertheless“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Despite” and “in spite of” need a noun after them; as a sentence linker use “nevertheless”.

mistakes.text: The chain was rusted through; although, the bike rolled by noon.
mistakes.normalized: the chain was rusted through although the bike rolled by noon
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Although“ aj „even though“ uvádzajú vedľajšiu vetu, nestoja samy za bodkočiarkou. Treba „nevertheless“.

mistakes.feedback_en: “Although” and “even though” start a clause and can't stand alone after a semicolon; use “nevertheless”.
